shortDescription: Create and manage reverse DNS entries on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: dns_ptr
options.description: The DNS address the I(ip_address) should resolve to. Omit the param to reset the reverse DNS entry to the default value.

options.name: floating_ip
options.description: Name or ID of the Hetzner Cloud Floating IP you want to add the reverse DNS entry to.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: The IP address that should point to I(dns_ptr).

options.name: load_balancer
options.description: Name or ID of the Hetzner Cloud Load Balancer you want to add the reverse DNS entry to.

options.name: primary_ip
options.description: Name or ID of the Hetzner Cloud Primary IP you want to add the reverse DNS entry to.

options.name: server
options.description: Name or ID of the Hetzner Cloud server you want to add the reverse DNS entry to.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the reverse DNS entry.
